description: This Java class 'DistributedPubWithTopicExtractor' implements the 'DistributedPub' interface, wrapping a delegate 'DistributedPub' and using a 'PubSubTopicExtractor' to determine topics for publishing messages. It provides methods to retrieve the publisher actor and to wrap messages for publication with associated topics.

classes.name: DistributedPubWithTopicExtractor
classes.description: Final class implementing 'DistributedPub' interface, using generics for message type T, wrapping another 'DistributedPub' delegate and a 'PubSubTopicExtractor' for topic extraction.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of 'DistributedPubWithTopicExtractor' given a delegate 'DistributedPub' and a 'PubSubTopicExtractor'.

methods.name: getPublisher
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef publisher from the delegate.

methods.name: wrapForPublication
methods.description: Wraps a message of type T for publication by extracting topics using 'topicExtractor' and creating a 'Publisher.Publish' message.
